text_en: When they had come near Jerusalem and had reached Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
text_cn: 当他们临近耶路撒冷，来到靠近橄榄山的贝特法革时，耶稣就打发两个门徒，

text_en: saying to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her; untie them and bring them to me.
text_cn: 对他们说：“你们往对面的村庄里去，立时会看见一匹拴着的母驴，和跟它在一起的驴驹。解开，给我牵来！

text_en: If anyone says anything to you, just say this, ‘The Lord needs them. ’ And he will send them immediately. ”
text_cn: 如果有人对你们说什么，你们就说：主要用它们。他就会立刻放它们来。”

text_en: This took place to fulfill what had been spoken through the prophet, saying,
text_cn: 这事发生，是为应验先知所说的：

text_en: “Tell the daughter of Zion, Look, your king is coming to you, humble, and mounted on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey. ”
text_cn: “你们应向熙雍女子说：看，你的君王来到你这里，温和的骑在一匹驴上，一匹母驴的小驴驹上。”

text_en: The disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them;
text_cn: 门徒就去，照耶稣吩咐他们的作了。

text_en: they brought the donkey and the colt, and put their cloaks on them, and he sat on them.
text_cn: 他们牵了母驴和驴驹来，把外衣搭在它们的身上，扶耶稣坐在上面。

text_en: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, and others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
text_cn: 很多群众，把自己的外衣铺在路上，还有些人从树上砍下树枝来，撒在路上。

text_en: The crowds that went ahead of him and that followed were shouting, “Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest heaven! ”
text_cn: 前行后随的群众喊说：“贺三纳于达味之子！因上主之名而来的，当受赞颂！贺三纳于至高之天！”

text_en: When he entered Jerusalem, the whole city was in turmoil, asking, “Who is this? ”
text_cn: 当耶稣进入耶路撒冷的时候，全城哄动，说：“这人是谁？”

text_en: The crowds were saying, “This is the prophet Jesus from Nazareth in Galilee. ”
text_cn: 群众说：“这是加里肋亚纳匝肋的先知耶稣。”

text_en: Then Jesus entered the temple and drove out all who were selling and buying in the temple, and he overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.
text_cn: 耶稣进了圣殿，把一切在圣殿内的商人顾客赶出去，把钱庄的桌子和卖鸽子的凳子推翻，

text_en: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer’; but you are making it a den of robbers. ”
text_cn: 向他们说：“经上记载：‘我的殿宇，应称为祈祷之所。’你们竟把它做成了贼窝。”

text_en: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he cured them.
text_cn: 在圣殿内的瞎子和瘸子来到他跟前，他都治好了他们。

text_en: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the amazing things that he did, and heard the children crying out in the temple, “Hosanna to the Son of David, ” they became angry
text_cn: 司祭长及经师见了他所行的奇事，又听见了孩子们在圣殿内喊说：“贺三纳于达味之子！”就大发忿怒，

text_en: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying? ” Jesus said to them, “Yes; have you never read, ‘Out of the mouths of infants and nursing babies you have prepared praise for yourself’? ”
text_cn: 对耶稣说：“你听见他们所说的吗？”耶稣对他们说：“是的，你们从未读过：‘你由婴儿和吃奶者的口中，备受赞美’这句话吗？”

text_en: He left them, went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.
text_cn: 于是便离开他们走出城外，到伯达尼去，在那里过夜。

text_en: In the morning, when he returned to the city, he was hungry.
text_cn: 早晨，他回城时，饿了，

text_en: And seeing a fig tree by the side of the road, he went to it and found nothing at all on it but leaves. Then he said to it, “May no fruit ever come from you again! ” And the fig tree withered at once.
text_cn: 见路旁有棵无花果树，就走到跟前，但在树上除了叶子外，什么也没找着，就对它说：“你永远不再结果子了！”那无花果树立即枯干了。

text_en: When the disciples saw it, they were amazed, saying, “How did the fig tree wither at once? ”
text_cn: 门徒一见，就惊异说：“怎么这无花果树立即枯干了？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what has been done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea, ’ it will be done.
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“我实在告诉你们：你们如果有信德，不疑惑，不但能对无花果树做这件事，即便你们对这座山说：起来，投到海中！也必要实现。

text_en: Whatever you ask for in prayer with faith, you will receive. ”
text_cn: 不论你们在祈祷时恳求什么，只要信，就必获得。”

text_en: When he entered the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority are you doing these things, and who gave you this authority? ”
text_cn: 他进了圣殿，正教训人时，司祭长和民间的长老来到他跟前说：“你凭什么权柄作这些事？谁给了你这种权柄？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “I will also ask you one question; if you tell me the answer, then I will also tell you by what authority I do these things.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我也问你们一句话，你们若答复我，我就告诉你们：我凭什么权柄作这些事。

text_en: Did the baptism of John come from heaven, or was it of human origin? ” And they argued with one another, “If we say, ‘From heaven, ’ he will say to us, ‘Why then did you not believe him? ’
text_cn: 若翰的洗礼，是从哪里来的？是从天上来的？还是从人来的？”他们心中思量说：如果我们说：是从天上来的，他必对我们说：你们为什么不信他？

text_en: But if we say, ‘Of human origin, ’ we are afraid of the crowd; for all regard John as a prophet. ”
text_cn: 如果我们说：是从人来的，我们害怕民众，因为众人都以若翰为一位先知。

text_en: So they answered Jesus, “We do not know. ” And he said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
text_cn: 他们便回答耶稣说：“我们不知道。”耶稣也对他们说：“我也不告诉你们：我凭什么权柄作这些事。”

text_en: “What do you think? A man had two sons; he went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work in the vineyard today. ’
text_cn: “你们以为怎样？从前有一个人，有两个儿子，他对第一个说：孩子！你今天到葡萄园里去工作吧！

text_en: He answered, ‘I will not’; but later he changed his mind and went.
text_cn: 他回答说：主，我去。但他却没有去。

text_en: The father went to the second and said the same; and he answered, ‘I go, sir’; but he did not go.
text_cn: 他对第二个也说了同样的话，第二个却答应说：我不愿意。但后来悔悟过来，而又去了。

text_en: Which of the two did the will of his father? ” They said, “The first. ” Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are going into the kingdom of God ahead of you.
text_cn: 二人中哪一个履行了父亲的意愿？”他们说：“后一个。”耶稣对他们说：“我实在告诉你们：税吏和娼妓要在你们以先进入天国，

text_en: For John came to you in the way of righteousness and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him; and even after you saw it, you did not change your minds and believe him.
text_cn: 因为若翰来到你们这里履行了正义，你们仍不相信他，税吏和娼妓倒相信了；至于你们，见了后，仍不悔悟去相信他。”

text_en: “Listen to another parable. There was a landowner who planted a vineyard, put a fence around it, dug a wine press in it, and built a watchtower. Then he leased it to tenants and went to another country.
text_cn: “你们再听一个比喻吧！从前有一个家主，培植了一个葡萄园，周围围上篱笆，园内掘了一个榨酒池，筑了一个守望台，把它租给园户，就离开了本国。

text_en: When the harvest time had come, he sent his slaves to the tenants to collect his produce.
text_cn: 快到收果子的时节，他打发仆人到园户那里去收果子。

text_en: But the tenants seized his slaves and beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
text_cn: 园户拿住了仆人，将一个鞭打了，将一个杀了，将另一个用石头砸死了。

text_en: Again he sent other slaves, more than the first; and they treated them in the same way.
text_cn: 他再打发一些仆人去，人数比以前还多；园户也一样对待了他们，

text_en: Finally he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son. ’
text_cn: 最后他打发自己的儿子到他们那里去，说：他们会敬重我的儿子。

text_en: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to themselves, ‘This is the heir; come, let us kill him and get his inheritance. ’
text_cn: 但园户一看见是儿子，就彼此说：这是继承人；来！我们杀掉他，我们就能得到他的产业。

text_en: So they seized him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
text_cn: 于是他们拿住他，把他推到园外杀了。

text_en: Now when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants? ”
text_cn: 那么，当葡萄园的主人来时，他要怎样处置那些园户呢？”

text_en: They said to him, “He will put those wretches to a miserable death, and lease the vineyard to other tenants who will give him the produce at the harvest time. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“要凶恶地消灭那些凶恶的人，把葡萄园另租给按时给他缴纳出产的园户。”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the scriptures: ‘The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; this was the Lord’s doing, and it is amazing in our eyes’?
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“‘匠人弃而不用的石头，反而成了屋角的基石；那是上主的所行所为，在我们眼中，神妙莫测’的这句经文， 你们没有读过吗？

text_en: Therefore I tell you, the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people that produces the fruits of the kingdom.
text_cn: 为此，我对你们说：天主的国，必由你们中夺去，而交给结果子的外邦人。

text_en: The one who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; and it will crush anyone on whom it falls. ”
text_cn: 跌在这石头上的，必被撞碎；这石头落在谁身上，必要把他压碎。”

text_en: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they realized that he was speaking about them.
text_cn: 司祭长和法利塞人听了他的这些比喻，觉出他是指着他们说的，

text_en: They wanted to arrest him, but they feared the crowds, because they regarded him as a prophet.
text_cn: 就想逮住他；但害怕民众，因为他们以耶稣为一位先知。
